answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via proof of burn, where agents destroy scarce cryptocurrency to mint identity tickets. Nodes verify receipts anchored in a grove of state trees instead of trusting a shifting dune of unbacked peers. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of permanently sacrificed capital per identity, driving exploit returns to an unprofitable nadir. However, burning assets creates a regressive barrier that penalizes honest, capital-constrained agents.
